description: Read the investor's own PitchSpark deal pipeline: for each pitch, its stage (sparked, deck_requested, in_conversation, due_diligence, invested), when it last moved and whether it is archived. Optionally one pitch_id. Use when: the investor asks where a deal stands. Do not use for: moving a deal (not available through this server; use PitchSpark), other investors' pipelines (never). Requires a PitchSpark API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation). Only the key owner's own rows are read. Notes and investment amounts are never returned (has_notes says whether there are notes). Pitches no longer public or opted out are left out (unavailable_count). Up to 50 items. Read-only; uses none of the daily pitch allowance.

include_archived.description: true: also list deals the investor archived (passed or removed). false (default): active deals only.

pitch_id.description: Optional: read the pipeline stage of this one pitch only (the "id" of a search result, copied exactly). Leave out to list every pipeline row.

name: pitchspark_pipeline_stage_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Read your deal pipeline
